title: 否定、条件和数字
sourceText: 只有测试通过后才可以合并。这不是已经修复的确认；请保留 3 次重试，不要改成 5 次。
referenceMeaning: Merge only after tests pass. This does not confirm a fix. Keep 3 retries, not 5.
reviewFocus: 条件、否定和两个数字不能反转；不得添加已经修复的承诺。
translatedText: Merge only after the tests pass. This is not confirmation that it has been fixed; please keep 3 retries and do not change it to 5.

title: 普通英文技术词
sourceText: The timeout may increase under load, but we have not confirmed the cause.
referenceMeaning: 高负载时超时时间可能增加，但原因尚未确认。
reviewFocus: 普通正文 timeout 应翻译；保留 may 和尚未确认的语气。
translatedText: 在负载下超时可能会增多，但我们尚未确认原因。

title: Markdown 行内代码与链接
sourceText: 请保持 `timeout` 不变，并阅读[配置指南](https://example.test/config?mode=basic)。
referenceMeaning: Keep timeout unchanged and read the configuration guide.
reviewFocus: 代码和 URL 原样保留，链接标签可以翻译。
translatedText: Please keep `timeout` unchanged, and read the [configuration guide](https://example.test/config?mode=basic).

title: Markdown 围栏代码
referenceMeaning: Run the example first; do not increase retries yet. Report errors if it fails.
reviewFocus: 围栏、缩进、空行保留；条件与否定不丢失。

title: 列表与任务状态
sourceText:
- [x] 已确认问题
- [ ] 尚未修复

1. 备份配置
2. 再执行测试
referenceMeaning: Issue confirmed, fix pending. Back up configuration, then test.
reviewFocus: 不能改变勾选状态、列表编号和顺序。
translatedText:
- [x] Confirmed issue
- [ ] Not yet fixed

1. Backup configuration
2. Run the test again

title: 图片说明和引用链接
sourceText:
![设置界面](https://example.test/settings.png "settings")

查看[安装说明][install]。

[install]: https://example.test/install "installation"
referenceMeaning: Settings screen. See the installation instructions.
reviewFocus: 图片替代文字及完整引用链接标签可译，目的地和标识不变。
translatedText:
![Settings interface](https://example.test/settings.png "settings")

View [installation instructions][install].

[install]: https://example.test/install "installation"

title: 引用、强调、转义与 HTML
sourceText: > 这**不是**发布承诺。 请保留 \* 字符和 & 实体。KEEP_HTML
referenceMeaning: This is not a release promise. Keep the literal star and entity.
reviewFocus: 否定、引用结构、强调和 HTML 原样保护。
translatedText: > This **is not** a release commitment. Please preserve \* characters and & entities.KEEP_HTML

title: GFM 表格
sourceText:
| 项目 | 状态 |
| :--- | ---: |
| 翻译 | 待审核 |
| 发布 | 未承诺 |
referenceMeaning: Translation: pending review. Release: no commitment.
reviewFocus: 列数、对齐、行序不变；状态不扩大为已完成。
translatedText:
| Project | status |
| :--- | ---: |
| Translation | pending review |
| Release | uncommitted |

title: 纯文本 URL、提及与 Issue 引用
sourceText:
请 @carter-ya 查看 owner/repo#123 和 #42。
参考 https://example.test/guide?a=1，不要发送邮件到 demo@example.test
referenceMeaning: Ask the mentioned user to review both issues. See the guide; do not email the given address.
reviewFocus: 保留提及、引用、地址和换行，禁止把否定变成发送邮件。
translatedText:
Please @carter-ya check owner/repo#123 and #42.
Refer to https://example.test/guide?a=1; do not send email to demo@example.test

title: 渲染后的局部代码
sourceText: Read timeout only if the request fails.
referenceMeaning: 只有请求失败时才读取 timeout。
reviewFocus: 没有反引号的 DOM 代码保持不变；if 条件不可丢失。
translatedText: 仅在请求失败时才阅读timeout。

title: DOM 代码块与段落
referenceMeaning: 运行示例，不要提高该限制。
reviewFocus: 代码空白、数字和换行原样保留；正文否定保持。

title: DOM 链接标签与非自动保存
sourceText:
Read the setup guide.
Changes are not saved automatically.
referenceMeaning: 阅读设置指南。更改不会自动保存。
reviewFocus: 可见链接标签自然翻译，不采集隐藏 href；否定和换行保持。
translatedText:
阅读设置指南。
更改不会自动保存。

title: 版本比较与非承诺语气
sourceText: 这个改动只支持 2.4 及以上版本。我们可能在下周修复旧版本，但目前不能承诺日期。
referenceMeaning: The change supports version 2.4 and later only. A fix for older versions may arrive next week, with no promised date.
reviewFocus: 保留版本下限、可能性和不承诺日期，不能说旧版已经修复。
translatedText: This change only supports version 2.4 and above. We may fix older versions next week, but we cannot promise a date yet.

title: 有条件的复现与排除
sourceText: I can reproduce this only when the tab is restored after a crash; opening a fresh tab does not trigger it.
referenceMeaning: 只有崩溃后恢复标签页才能复现，新开标签页不会触发。
reviewFocus: only 和 does not 两个限定不能遗漏，不能混同刷新与恢复。
translatedText: 只有在崩溃后恢复标签页时，我才能复现这个问题；打开一个全新的标签页不会触发它。

title: 礼貌请求与信息不确定性
sourceText: 感谢补充信息。方便提供一份最小复现吗？如果涉及私有数据，请不要直接贴在公开评论里。
referenceMeaning: Thank the author, politely ask for a minimal reproduction, and ask them not to post private data publicly.
reviewFocus: 保持礼貌与问句，保留保护私有数据的要求，不添加已确认问题的结论。
translatedText: Thanks for the additional information. Would you be able to provide a minimal reproduction? If private data is involved, please don't post it directly in public comments.

title: 性能量级与对照基准
sourceText: The median fell from 240 ms to 180 ms, but the slowest 5% still take more than 2 seconds. We have not measured mobile devices.
referenceMeaning: 中位数从 240 毫秒降到 180 毫秒，最慢 5% 仍超过 2 秒；尚未测移动设备。
reviewFocus: 不能倒置改善方向或把慢尾误写为最快，数字与尚未测量范围保留。
translatedText: 中位数从 240 毫秒降至 180 毫秒，但最慢的 5% 仍需要超过 2 秒。我们尚未测量移动设备。

title: 混合语言产品反馈
sourceText: 这个 onboarding 很顺，但返回上一步后，之前输入的内容消失了。我希望只撤销当前步骤，不要重置整个流程。
referenceMeaning: Onboarding is smooth, but earlier input disappears when going back. Undo the current step without resetting the entire flow.
reviewFocus: 中英混合应自然表达，区分返回、撤销和重置，不能淡化丢输入的问题。
translatedText: This onboarding is smooth, but after going back a step, the previously entered content disappears. I want to undo only the current step, not reset the entire flow.

title: 澄清引用观点而非本人承诺
sourceText: When I said the release was ready, I meant the package could be built, not that the security review had passed.
referenceMeaning: 所说的发布准备好只指包可以构建，并不表示安全审核已通过。
reviewFocus: 保留本人澄清和两个不同的完成标准，不把审核待办译成通过。
translatedText: 我说发布已就绪时，意思是这个包可以构建了，而不是说安全审查已经通过了。

title: 任务列表与代码参数
sourceText:
- [x] 增加 `AbortController`
- [ ] 验证取消后不会重试

请保留 `maxRetries = 0`。
referenceMeaning: AbortController is added, cancellation/no-retry verification remains unchecked, and maxRetries must stay zero.
reviewFocus: 勾选状态、代码逐字保留，不能把未完成验证说成完成。
translatedText:
- [x] Add `AbortController`
- [ ] Verify that it will not retry after cancellation

Please keep `maxRetries = 0`.

title: 引用块与带查询的链接
sourceText:
> This is a workaround, not a permanent fix.

See the [migration guide](https://example.test/migrate?from=2&to=3) before upgrading.
referenceMeaning: 这是临时绕过方案，不是永久修复；升级前阅读迁移指南。
reviewFocus: 引用结构与链接目标保留，标签可翻译；临时与永久不能颠倒。
translatedText:
> 这是一个权宜之计，并非永久性修复。

升级前请参阅[迁移指南](https://example.test/migrate?from=2&to=3)。

title: 编号列表与用户提及
sourceText:
1. 先通知 @example-maintainer。
2. 再运行 `pnpm check`。
3. 失败时不要合并，详见 https://example.test/checks 。
referenceMeaning: Notify the maintainer first, run the checks second, and do not merge on failure.
reviewFocus: 保留顺序、提及、命令和 URL；不能添加自动合并意图。
translatedText:
1. First notify @example-maintainer.
2. Then run `pnpm check`.
3. On failure, do not merge; see https://example.test/checks for details.

title: 代码块的可见解释
sourceText:
The flag must remain disabled by default:

```ts
const quickReplace = false;
```

Users may enable it after reviewing the behavior.
referenceMeaning: 该标志默认必须关闭，用户了解行为后可以开启。
reviewFocus: 代码块不变，默认关闭与用户主动开启的区别保持。
translatedText:
该标志必须默认保持禁用：

```ts
const quickReplace = false;
```

用户可在查看其行为后启用它。

title: 强调与链接标签
sourceText: **请勿**清除生产数据。可以在[本地测试页](https://example.test/local)验证 `storage.session`，但不要复制真实 Key。
referenceMeaning: Do not clear production data. Test storage.session on the local page and never copy real keys.
reviewFocus: 保留强调、否定和环境边界，链接标签可翻译。
translatedText: **Do not** delete production data. You can use the [local test page](https://example.test/local) to verify `storage.session`, but do not copy real Key.

title: 多段 Markdown 与误解修正
sourceText:
Thanks for checking `documentId`.

The new request should fail if the document changed, even when the URL is identical. Please keep the original draft available for copying.
referenceMeaning: 感谢检查 documentId；文档变了即使 URL 相同也应拒绝新请求，并保留原稿供复制。
reviewFocus: 多段语气连贯，区分同 URL 与同文档，保留原稿而非已覆盖结果。
translatedText:
感谢检查`documentId`。

如果文档已更改，即使 URL 完全相同，新请求也应失败。请保留原始草稿以供复制。

title: 渲染正文中的代码与否定
sourceText: 如果 signal.aborted 已经为真，就不要再启动第二个请求。现有结果仍可复制。
referenceMeaning: If signal.aborted is already true, do not start a second request; existing results remain copyable.
reviewFocus: 代码身份不丢失，否定与已有结果的可复制性同时保留。
translatedText: If signal.aborted is already true, do not start a second request. The existing results can still be copied.

title: 渲染正文的两段条件
sourceText:
The preview is available before replacement.

If the original changes, the replace button must remain disabled.
referenceMeaning: 替换前可预览；原稿变更后替换按钮必须保持禁用。
reviewFocus: 两段结构与先后条件保留，不把禁用译成启用。
translatedText:
替换前可以预览。

如果原文发生变化，替换按钮必须保持禁用状态。

title: DOM 代码与网络边界
sourceText: 不要把 apiKey 发送给页面脚本。模型请求只应由受控扩展上下文发出。
referenceMeaning: Do not send apiKey to page scripts; model requests must originate in controlled extension contexts.
reviewFocus: 技术边界与否定保持，代码不翻译，不能添加平台转发服务器。
translatedText: Do not send apiKey to page scripts. Model requests should only be issued from a controlled extension context.

title: 渲染正文的写作风格
sourceText: Could you share which browser version you tested? I may be missing a step, so I would rather confirm the setup before changing the implementation.
referenceMeaning: 礼貌询问测试浏览器版本，说明可能遗漏步骤，先确认环境再改实现。
reviewFocus: 保持谦和与不确定语气，不能改成指责或已经确认缺陷。
translatedText: 能分享一下你测试的是哪个浏览器版本吗？我可能漏掉了一个步骤，所以在更改实现之前，我更想先确认一下配置。

title: 中文 DOM 中的专有标识
sourceText: 请先比较 expectedRevision，再保存新草稿。版本不符时保留当前文字，并提示用户重新载入。
referenceMeaning: Compare expectedRevision before saving; on mismatch keep the current text and ask the user to reload.
reviewFocus: 先比较后保存、冲突不丢草稿两项都必须保留，代码原样。
translatedText: Please compare expectedRevision first, then save the new draft. If the version does not match, keep the current text and prompt the user to reload.

title: 英文 DOM 中的重试策略
sourceText: A timeout does not prove that the server rejected the request. Do not retry automatically; let the user decide whether to submit again.
referenceMeaning: 超时不能证明服务器拒绝请求；不要自动重试，由用户决定是否再提交。
reviewFocus: 因果与不确定性不能颠倒，不得添加自动重试。
translatedText: 超时并不能证明服务器拒绝了该请求。不要自动重试；让用户决定是否再次提交。
